credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: View of Georgia O'Keeffe walking with her long skirt blowing in the wind inside the gates of the Abiquiu grave yard, her back is to the viewer.  Adobe brick wall in foreground with lone tree with a dog at the entrance, mesa and cloud filled sky in background.
title: Abiquiu Grave Yard with Georgia O'Keeffe
